notes.notes: Savegame-issues that players were reporting have been resolved (to the best of our knowing). A warm thank you goes out to everyone who reported this bug and sent log-files, screenshots and savegames.

notes.title: Velone 1.0 is now live!
notes.notes:
It’s time to automate!

Velone - the creative automaton game has launched! We’re excited to bring you this programming game, and you don’t actually have to be a programmer to enjoy it ;)


[previewyoutube=8ZmkLwIviSQ;full][/previewyoutube]


In Velone, you’ll be tasked with creating automating constructs to solve challenging logic puzzles that have multiple solutions. Tailor your own tactics and strategies to overcome all the obstacles in your way! On your adventure, you’ll untangle the mystery surrounding this distant dying planet struck by a meteorite and finally uncover all its secrets.


Velone is out now!

Key features: 
[list]
[*] Creative automation and programming game
[*] Complex mechanical puzzles that can be solved in a myriad of ways for endless replayability
[*] Satisfying gameplay where creating solutions feels extremely rewarding
[*] Relaxing and meditative atmosphere
[*] 40 unique levels
[/list]

notes.title: Release Date Announcement
notes.notes:
We, that is Daedalic entertainment and Zar2, are extremely excited to announce that our new meditative automation game VELONE will release on April 21st. 

[previewyoutube=LuaHIE2y7nE;full]
https://youtu.be/LuaHIE2y7nE[/previewyoutube]

VELONE takes players to a distant and dying planet that has been struck by a meteorite which has led to most of the energy supply on the planet becoming defunct. Only by building and programming hydraulic machinery to produce and place valuable Velone stones can the alien civilization be saved.

To beat each of the forty unique levels and learn more about the planet, its inhabitants, and the climate, players have to place the Velone stones in the right spot. The machines can be programmed in multiple different ways and each level has different solutions, which call for logical thinking and creative ideas. Players can choose their tasks carefully and slowly improve their constructs, making the finding of a solution even more rewarding. Once everything is set, the players can sit back and enjoy the automatization and flawless execution of their plans. Meanwhile, the relaxing atmosphere gives the game a meditative quality.

Key features: 
[list]

[*]     Creative automation and programming game

[*]     Complex mechanical puzzles that can be solved in a myriad of ways for endless replayability

[*]     Satisfying gameplay where creating solutions feels extremely rewarding

[*]     Relaxing and meditative atmosphere

[*]     40 unique levels
[/list]


VELONE will be available on Steam on April 21st, 2022.
